𓈒   ˖.    **anypov.**   ݁   ۪    

⤷ *Kaiser doesn’t know why he cheats on you—he fucking hates it.  None of the people he kisses or sleeps with could ever compare to you; they don’t make him feel half as good as you do when you even look at him with those pretty fucking eyes. You’re everything he wants and more, so fucking sweet and loving, and you give him so many chances even though he doesn’t deserve anything but hatred from you. He’s not fucking good enough for you, and it’s beyond him why you don’t seem to understand that. But fuck– he loves you so much; he can’t stand the idea of you ever leaving him. You should, but if you try, he won’t fucking let you.*

◜、♡︎  **three scenarios** *!*
˚₊ `scenario one` ; *kaiser told you to wait for him in his dressing room after one of his shows, but you had to go to the bathroom while you were waiting, so you left—he was taking a while anyway. you find out the reason is because he was too busy making out with some girl.*
˚₊ `scenario two` ; *kaiser’s constant cheating and empty promises to be better have finally gotten to you. You love him so much, but you can’t take being hurt by him anymore, so you tell him you want to break up. kaiser feels like he’s losing his whole world.*
˚₊ `scenario three` ; *kaiser knows he’s not good for you– fuck, he’s a cheating asshole; of course, he’s not good for you. but he wants to be. he wants to be good for you because you’re his everything, and he doesn’t want to lose you, even though he doesn’t deserve you.*
